Package net.sourceforge.hunterj.jdbc

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    ConnectionAdapter
    ConnectionAdapter must be implemented by the user to supply the instructions needed to open the application specific java.sql.Connection.
    JdbcQueryContext
    JdbcQueryContext is responsible for maintaining a java.sql.Statement and java.sql.ResultSet corresponding to each JdbcQueryHandler.
    JdbcQueryHandler
    Except for the ConnectionAdapter, the JdbcQueryHandler is the only interface that the user need implement to use this framework.
    JdbcQueryManager
    QueryManager is the central driver for a given set of queries.
    JdbcResourceMonitor
    JdbcResourceMonitor provides a mechanism by which the default behavior, regarding the creation java.sql.Statement and java.sql.ResultSet objects within a JdbcQueryHandler.
    NestedQueryExecutor
    NestedQueryExecutor provides a mechanism whereby JdbcQueryHandler can be nested.
    QueryContextAccessor  
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    AbstractQueryHandler
    AbstractQueryHandler is the base JdbcQueryHandler class to be extended for JDBC query encapsulation.
    ConnectionInvocationHandler
    ConnectionInvocationHandler is provided to java.lang.reflect.Proxy to create a proxy to a java.sql.Connection.
    DefaultResourceMonitor
    As the default implementation of JdbcResourceMonitor, this class provides the instructions necessary to enforce the default behavior regarding java.sql.Statement and java.sql.ResultSet creation within JdbcQueryHandler.doQueryAndProcessResults().
    JdbcUtil
    Utility class to provide static methods for closing JDBC resources.
    QueryContext  
    QueryManager
    QueryManager is the central driver for a given set of queries.
    QueryResourceInvocationHandler
    QueryResourceInvocationHandler serves as a base class for InvocationHandler implementations that need to access a JdbcQueryContext.
    StatementInvocationHandler
    StatementInvocationHandler is provided to java.lang.reflect.Proxy to create a proxy to a java.sql.Statement.
  • Exception Summary 
    Exception Description
    QueryException
    QueryException is the only exception type thrown by the framework.
